cost_models.constant: frozen ctx: profile cpu cost + ORACLE_COST_EST constant
cost_models.loo: mean labelled total_cost_s on the other events of the cohort (deployable)
cost_models.measured: the event's own labelled total_cost_s (upper bound)
cost_models.loo_exact / measured_exact: same estimates, no 1e-9 floor: baseline_costs = est and all ORACLE_COST_EST entries set to 0 in memory while these models run, so every selector ranks / budgets by exactly est (see clamp_counts for why).
cost_models.injection: baseline_costs = max(est - ORACLE_COST_EST[oracle_type], 1e-9); cheapest_first and diversity_only rank by baseline_costs (= est - oracle constant) while proposed, decomposed and the composite variants rank by expected_cost (= est).

description.s1_prioritisation: Prioritisation view (budget=inf). auc = area under detection-vs-labelled-budget (1 - normalised labelled cost to first detection; 0 if never detected). tests_to_first_detection is 1-based (len+1 if none); labelled_s_to_first_detection includes the first detecting unit (full suite if none). random: mean over seeds 0..99 (auc_seeds0_19 kept for the sanity check). Random ranking does not depend on costs, so it is identical across models.
description.s2_paired_tests: Paired comparisons on r4-rounded per-event AUCs (scale-up is the requested cohort; primary also given). mean_diff = mean(a-b) unrounded; wins = a>b. Wilcoxon two-sided, method='auto', with zero_method wilcox (drops zero differences) and pratt. Sign test: exact binomial on wins vs losses. Permutation: sign-flip of nonzero differences, statistic |sum d|, exact enumeration if <=20 nonzero.
description.s3_mechanism: Constant model. For proposed and diversity_only: rank of first detecting unit; units ranked before it with labelled cost > 10.0 s (with constant-model expected cost, label oracle_strength, n_qubits). Summary: share of the labelled cost spent before first detection that comes from units whose labelled cost > 100.0x their constant-model expected cost (pooled over events, and mean/median of per-event fractions over events with nonzero pre-detection cost). Headline: detected_events_only. In including_undetected_events, an undetected event contributes the whole ranking (the full labelled suite) as 'before', identically for every selector.
description.s4_cost_decomposition: Labelled total_cost_s per event split into cpu_time_s (baseline transpilation, the 'transpilation component') and oracle_cost_s; top-4/top-8 shares; share on units whose label never attributes this cohort's fault in any event. verification: total == cpu + oracle; label cpu_time_s == baseline profile cost_median_s (so candidate/mutant transpilation is NOT charged; the candidate transpilation medians recorded in details.performance are reported separately as 'recorded_not_charged'); range of label cpu_time_s across events per unit (0 => event-independent cached baseline cost). frozen_T_full_s = 2 x nightly budget.
description.s5_frozen_budgets: Finite-budget selection with the frozen pr/nightly budgets in seconds. Each selector is called with budget_s = frozen budget on the model-injected context (so the budget is enforced in the model's own cost units); the selected set is then charged its labelled cost. proposed uses its default reserve_frac=0.15 (the tier's exploration_reserve_frac is not read by proposed_selector). Random: seeds 0..19, averaged within event first. Composite variants (additive/lex) are ranking-only and are not included. mean_model_estimated_s is the spend as the model sees it.
description.s6_decomposed_vs_diversity: Per event and model (constant is the requested one): Kendall tau (scipy tau-b on positions) and number of differing positions between decomposed and diversity_only full rankings; n_tiebreak_changes = greedy steps at which decomposed's pick differs from the pick the same key without the -severity term would make from the same remaining-list state; plus a full no-tie-break copy ranking (tau, differing positions, AUC). Note: diversity_only sorts by baseline_cost while decomposed sorts by expected_cost (baseline + per-oracle-type constant), which can reorder units independently of severity.
description.s7_operator_classes: Scale-up only (primary has the same split given for completeness). Mean prioritisation AUC per selector for gate-insertion events (event_id contains 'insert-redundant') vs all other events.

sanity_checks.note: Deterministic AUCs were additionally cross-checked inline against cart.metrics.evaluate._run_metrics (exact float equality, all models/selectors/events); the local decomposed copy was asserted to reproduce decomposed_selector exactly under every model; injected expected_cost was asserted to equal the LOO / measured estimate wherever the 1e-9 clamp does not bind; every finite-budget selection was asserted to respect the frozen budget under the model's own expected_cost.
